shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile in low relief
monolithic upright block/pillar carrying carved imagery
curved band or arc motif spanning the surface
justification: Both are upright monolithic surfaces bearing low-relief carving with schematic curved bands, but the depicted content differs sharply: A shows an anthropomorphic figure with a head, ornamented headdress, circular disc emblem and a belt-like band across the torso, while B shows animals in profile (a quadruped over a longer serpentine/quadruped form) with no human elements. The only real overlap is the generic presence of relief carving with curved lines on a standing block, which any tradition could produce independently.
